verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud hosting platform, so programmatic custom-domain provisioning for SaaS tenants is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions custom domains, a domain API, or per-tenant domain routing. The only nearby items are generic: auto-provisioned public endpoints and SSL, an AI agent that can 'wire up networking', and a CLI and MCP server with no documented domain operations. These are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers
